Supreme Court issues notice to CEC, reprimands Rahul Gandhi

The Supreme Court has issued a notice to Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar regarding his conduct. Chief Justice of India (CJI) DY Chandrachud reprimanded Rahul Gandhi for his statement about marching to the Supreme Court. The court also issued notices to Mallikarjun Kharge and Akhilesh Yadav.
